claims.text: Beta-blockers and CCBs are second-line (ACE inhibition also protects the glomeruli: ↓ intraglomerular pressure and ↓ rate of GFR decline w proteinuria).
claims.quote: ACE inhibition also protects the glomeruli by decreasing intraglomerular pressure and reducing the rate of GFR decline in those with proteinuria. Beta-blockers and calcium-channel blockers are second-line treatments.
